_comment: Release gate A15: every download program a source knows is in the catalogue or excluded with a reason. The catalogue is the program types of src/lib/programs/catalog.ts under the names these sources spell them (source-names.json, held to catalog.ts by catalog.test.ts). Sonarr and Radarr list the download programs they drive, one folder each. pyLoad and JDownloader appear in neither list.

excluded.Blackhole: Sonarr and Radarr only write a .torrent, magnet or .nzb file into a folder and scan a watch folder themselves, so no program with an address stands behind it — Sonarr/Sonarr@c018578e4b79 src/NzbDrone.Core/Download/Clients/Blackhole/TorrentBlackhole.cs:74
excluded.Pneumatic: Pneumatic is a Kodi add-on that hands every NZB to SABnzbd, so the download runs in SABnzbd, which the catalogue carries as a program of its own — TsUPeR/xbmc-pneumatic@a5d81b84b236 addon.xml:8
